idea-plugin.name: Intella Spring
idea-plugin.description:
Spring & Spring Boot support for IntelliJ IDEA on the free tier: bean model across XML and Java configuration, autowiring analysis, gutter navigation, a Spring Boot run configuration with actuator tabs, and configuration-metadata completion for application.properties / application.yml.

The Spring plugins bundled with IDEA are Ultimate-license-gated; this plugin brings comparable assistance to everyone. It depends only on the platform, Java, Properties and YAML support.
